name: Wuhan East Lake High Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuhan East Lake High Technology Group Co., Ltd. operates across three primary business sectors: engineering construction, environmental protection technology, and the development of technology parks. Within engineering construction, the company manages the full project lifecycle, from initial investment and development through to construction, operation, and maintenance of significant infrastructure, including highways, major bridges, and municipal facilities. Its involvement in technology parks mirrors this comprehensive approach, encompassing their investment, development, construction, and ongoing operation. Furthermore, the group provides a range of environmental solutions, including the management of flue gas treatment, urban sewage systems, lake water purification, ecological restoration initiatives, solid waste processing, and new energy projects. Established in 1993, the company maintains its headquarters in Wuhan, China.
